**Getting around**

**Commands**
`/syncroles` – give/remove the ✅ Verified role for every player claim *(managers)*
`/aispike` – one-off test of the Workers AI image + text models *(owner only)*

-# PHOENIX STATS · HELP
## Step by step
-# Some jobs need more than one command. Do them in this order.

**Your end-of-season Rush card**
**1.** `/seasoncard scan` – Attach a screenshot of your Rush season stats.
**2.** `Check the reading` – The bot shows what it read. Wrong numbers? Press Edit on the site instead.
**3.** `Save my card` – Saves it and posts it in the season channel. You have 15 minutes, or press Discard.
**4.** `/seasoncard mine` – Shows your saved card and where you rank.

**The club Rush ladder (managers)**
**1.** `/rushladder scan` – Attach a photo of the Rush leaderboard.
**2.** `It reads and saves` – If the photo is clear it saves and posts. If not, it says what to fix and sends you to the site.
**3.** `/rushladder latest` – Shows the most recent ladder.

**Find a player**
**1.** `/player` – Start typing a gamertag, pick it, get the stats card.
**2.** `/compare` – Put two players side by side.
**3.** `/profile` – A member’s positions, platforms and claim.

**Awards and points**
**1.** `/awards` – This week’s ballot and last week’s winners.
**2.** `/motm` – The Man of the Match vote for the latest game.
**3.** `/points` – Your total and where it came from.

**Track a burner club (managers)**
**1.** `/burner recent` – Pick from clubs our players also play in, no typing.
**2.** `/burner search` – Or search EA by name or club ID.
**3.** `/burner track` – Start tracking, stats arrive after every game.
**4.** `/burner list · remove` – See what you track, or stop.

Managers only. Times show in everyone’s own time zone. Choose League or Rush as the mode.

**2.** `/queue board` – Posts the live queue board in the configured channel.
**3.** `/queue status` – Anyone can see the line.
